messages:
maya: quick preflight for the EU-2 cutover tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Can each owner drop a one-line status (green/yellow/red) + any blockers? Leaving time for rollback discussion.

dan: platform green — routing policy applied to staging, feature flags in place. Need someone to ack the residency header tests.

sophia: infra yellow — VPN tunnel between eu-2 and core control plane still flaky; raised ticket with cloud provider. ETA 6h but may affect control-plane metrics.

liam: security-bot says last compliance scan passed, but we still need KMS rotation note from security. security-bot: "KMS keys in eu-2 provisioned, automatic rotation enabled. Audit logs forwarding to SIEM needs config (pending)."

ingrid: ops red on runbook: our current cutover script assumes global DNS TTL 300, but DNS TTL is 60 for some customers. Need to add a pre-cutover TTL sync step.

maya: noted on TTL. @ingrid can you add the TTL step and paste the command you want ops to run?

ingrid: sure — add this before switching traffic:
```bash
# reduce TTL to 60 for affected zones
for zone in $(cat affected-zones.txt); do
  gcloud dns record-sets transaction start --zone=$zone
  gcloud dns record-sets transaction remove --zone=$zone --name="app.example.com." --ttl=300 --type=A 1.2.3.4 || true
  gcloud dns record-sets transaction add --zone=$zone --name="app.example.com." --ttl=60 --type=A 1.2.3.4
  gcloud dns record-sets transaction execute --zone=$zone
done
```

dan: routing policy snippet (staging) — please review residency toggle and fallback behavior:
```yaml
routing_rule:
  name: eu-2-primary
  match: region==eu && capacity>=20
  actions:
    - route: eu-2
      residency: true
    - route: eu-1
      residency: false
      fallback: true
```

sophia: confirm that the audit log forwarding is the only open security item? @liam

liam: yes — SIEM forwarding needs endpoint details from ops. Also need legal signoff for e-residency customers; @maya can you confirm legal loop closed?

maya: legal got the memo yesterday, they flagged one contract clause for EU-residency customers — we have a patch in the template, legal says ok with patch. Marking legal = green.

ops: ops green on runbook updates once @ingrid pushes TTL snippet to runbook.md and we get the final SIEM endpoint. We'll also run a dry-run at 07:30 UTC.

deploy-bot: Canary pipeline scheduled for 2026-03-18T08:30:00Z — jobs: [smoke-tests, residency-checks, latency-bench].

manual-check: liam, can you confirm the residency acceptance tests include sticky-session and cookie-less flows?

liam: yes — test suite has both. Added an extra test for KV-cache locality which failed in one staging run; fixed and requeued.

maya: summary: platform green, infra yellow (VPN ETA), security green (pending SIEM endpoint), ops green after runbook update, legal green. Blockers: VPN ticket and SIEM endpoint. Plan: hold cutover if VPN not resolved by 07:00 UTC, otherwise proceed with 09:00 UTC cutover and 07:30 dry-run.

maya: please react with :thumbsup: if you ack the plan or :x: if you need us to hold.

liam: :thumbsup:

dan: :thumbsup:

ingrid: :thumbsup:

sophia: :thumbsup:

maya: thanks all — I'll post final go/no-go at 08:00 UTC in this thread and pin the runbook link.
